kevin (AE): Quick heads-up — customer wants a short-term POC on reserved GPU capacity but with a daily burst allowance. They want pricing clarity and deal-desk approval before legal signs the SOW. Quote Q-8421 attached.

sarah (SE): What are the exact numbers? pool size, GPU type, and expected burst pattern?

kevin (AE): 8x A100 reserved (monthly commit). Burst allowed up to 2x for ~2-3 hours/day during demo window (two-week POC). Asking for a one-off burst discount for POC. Customer is okay w/ a formal cap.

devon (Infra): Technically fine. Autoscale can add standby hosts but burst is billed as "on-demand" unless we carve a temporary burst SKU. Need to know if they require guaranteed burst capacity or best-effort. Guaranteed = reserve extra capacity, impacts availability for others.

sarah (SE): They said "guaranteed for demo hours". So we need a carveout or a temporary pool swap. That triggers reserved capacity planning.

maria (Finance): For POC discounts we need ARR and contract term to model. Typical approach: 6mo minimum for any discounted reserved pricing, or a 1-3 month introductory promo with an explicit cap. Do we know contract length?

kevin (AE): Likely 12mo if POC goes well. For now they want a 2-week POC with the option to convert.

olivia (Deal Desk): Proposed structure for review: one-time POC burst allowance with a hard cap and elevated per-burst rate. If they convert to a 12mo commit within 30 days, refund the excess burst premium back as credits. Draft terms below — needs deal-desk + finance OK.

olivia (Deal Desk): ```
pricing_snippet:
  base_rate_per_A100_hour: $6.00
  reserved_discount: 30% (applies when commit signed)
  poc_burst_rate_multiplier: 1.25 (applies to on-demand hours during POC)
  poc_burst_cap_hours: 400 total across pod
  conversion_credit: refund burst premium if converted to 12mo within 30 days
  minimum_term_for_discount: 6 months (preferred 12)
```

devon (Infra): Two operational notes: 1) if we honor guaranteed burst we must pin capacity and that reduces available buffer for other customers — ops wants the cap explicit. 2) autoscale warm-up means first ~30-60s may spike latency; call that out in SLOs.

maria (Finance): That pricing snippet is reasonable as a POC concession. We need the customer to sign an addendum that lists the burst cap and the conversion credit clause. Also require finance to own the rebate accounting — please add quote line items.

kevin (AE): I'll ask the customer to sign the addendum. They also asked for SOC2 report and KMS integration for the private key. Any blockers?

devon (Infra): SOC2 report is fine, we can share. KMS integration depends on whether POC is hosted or private. For hosted POC we can do customer-managed keys via our KMS integration but needs an onboarding ticket. That could add ~3 business days.

ops-bot: Quote Q-8421 created: https://redwood.internal/quotes/Q-8421 (internal link).

olivia (Deal Desk): Action items: (1) kevin to send signed POC addendum with burst cap, (2) sarah to confirm exact demo schedule (hours/day), (3) devon to open KMS onboarding ticket if customer needs CMK, (4) maria to prepare provisional invoice with a burst line item and cap. I'll escalate to VP if any exception beyond 30% discount is needed.

kevin (AE): Customer will sign tonight. Demo hours are M-F 1100-1400 PST. I'll update the quote.

maria (Finance): Ok — provisional invoice ready once addendum received. Will mark as "POC concession" and set accounting note for potential credit on conversion.

olivia (Deal Desk): I'll tentatively approve the POC terms above. Final sign-off when I see the signed addendum and exact demo hours. If finance or infra raise issues, we'll hold.

kevin (AE): Thanks — will post the signed addendum and update quote Q-8421 here when done. :thumbsup:
